## Work

Yaqub owns the TypeScript frontend at [iZone Iraq](https://www.izoneiraq.com/) (Apr 2024 – Present): five commerce storefronts, 15,000+ monthly users, React Router (Remix), Tailwind CSS, trilingual RTL, Laravel APIs, Mapbox, and payments.

He previously built the Next.js client for [Botolon](https://www.botolon.com/) (Nov 2023 – Apr 2025) and the Vue.js frontend for [ErbilianWay](https://erbiliantravel.com/).

## Stack

React, TypeScript, Remix, Next.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Mapbox, Sass, Vue.js.

## Education

BSc Software Engineering, Koya University, Erbil (Nov 2020 – May 2024).
